senses.definition: n.f. guard, watch?—only וְחָנִיתִי לְבֵיתִי מ׳ Zc 9:8 and I encamp as watch for my house (so We Now GASm, but dub.; Kue Sta Marti Kau GASm read מַצָּבָה, but this prob. non-existent, v. supr.; MT appar. intends because of a host = מִצָּבָא).
